tpms.when: 2009 CLK with the tire pressure monitor in the cluster and a reset button
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire and loading sticker on the driver's door pillar (or inside the fuel filler flap).
Switch the ignition on and stay parked.
Use the steering wheel buttons to page to the standard display (the one with the odometer).
Use the other pair of steering wheel arrow buttons to scroll until the display reads Tire Pressure Monitor Active.
Press the reset button. The display asks whether to restart the tire pressure monitor.
Confirm with the steering wheel button the display indicates.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light flashes for about a minute when you start the car and then stays on, the warning system itself has a fault. A reset won't fix it; have it checked.
